blurb: Skydive Midwest offers skydiving experiences from 14,500 feet with freefall speeds over 120 mph and freefall times over 60 seconds. They prioritize safety as a USPA member and provide experiences for first-time jumpers, experienced jumpers, and those seeking licensing. Their fleet can accommodate up to 23 jumpers at a time.
